description: This file defines the 'Actions' class, a Drupal render element used to group form buttons, including processing and pre-rendering logic for dropbutton grouping.

classes.name: Actions
classes.description: A render element class that provides a wrapper for grouping form buttons, with support for dropbutton grouping and processing.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns processing and theming info for the Actions element, including pre-render callbacks.

methods.name: processActions
methods.description: Adds the 'form-actions' CSS class to the element's attributes.

methods.name: preRenderActionsDropbutton
methods.description: Pre-render callback that groups child elements with a #dropbutton property into dropbuttons.
